dedupe_keys.name: wademest water demand estimation tool for residential areas

description: WaDemEsT simulates household water consumption in urban residential areas. Kamil Aybuğa published the model through CoMSES Net. It represents household demographics, appliance use, daily routines, weather, seasonal variation and holidays. Its documented setup compares simulated demand with monthly consumption data and a daily heuristic demand model. Coverage is a configurable residential setting; the metadata does not identify a transferable calibration area or a fixed spatial grid. It supports agent-based demand estimation for water-supply planning. The source describes intended forecasting uses, but this review has not independently assessed predictive accuracy. Release 1.0.0 is available free through the CoMSES code repository and lists Netlogo 6.4.0. The release licence is GPL-3.0. Source code and model data were not downloaded or executed. Related resources include the CoMSES computational model library.
